_comment: Food equivalence table. Hunger values: 7Days uses 0-100 scale (food stat), Minecraft uses 0-20 (hunger bar = 2 per shank).
_columns: id_7days | id_minecraft | name_en | name_es | hunger_7days | hunger_mc | saturation_mc | cooked | v1 | verified | notes
_hunger_7days: value added to food stat (0-100). Source: items.xml triggered_effect foodAmountAdd. Marked with ? if unverified.
_hunger_mc: hunger points restored (each = 0.5 shanks shown on bar). Source: MC wiki / jar data.
_data_source: items.xml (7Days food items), Minecraft jar assets/minecraft/data/recipe (MC values)
_coverage_v1: 3/3 raw meats covered; cooked variants V2
_creative_note: In creative mode all food items available including V2+

raw_meats._note: 7Days: adds 2 food, risk of dysentery. MC: raw beef. 1-to-1 on kill but flavor differs.
Same 7Days item, different MC equivalent depending on source mob

cooked_meats._note: 7Days hunger value unverified — read from items.xml FoodValue CVar chain

eggs_and_misc._note: MC egg is thrown, not eaten. 7Days foodEgg IS eaten. Treat as: throw=MC behavior, eat=7Days behavior.

v2_flag: _note: V2 adds crops (wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, melon, pumpkin, sugarcane) with farm mechanics. Cooked meats also move to V2 (requires furnace cooking chain).
